methodologyNote: Measured via page views; OS families combined (e.g. Windows).

aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Japan at 77.55% (market share of tracked page views / usage). OS X ranked second at 10.19%, followed by macOS at 5.82%.

faqs.question: Which item leads operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Japan?
faqs.answer: Windows leads at 77.55% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/os-market-share/desktop/japan.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Japan?
faqs.answer: Windows (77.55%), OS X (10.19%), macOS (5.82%) in October 2026.
